### Biography
Jamie is a PDRA in Medical Statistics at the University of Manchester, currently working on the RESHAPE-CARE project, using causal inference methods to contribute to the development of a systems-engineering approach to modelling patients with multiple long-term health conditions. He completed a PhD in Mathematical Biology, where his research focused on developing a within-host model of inhalational anthrax infection and modelling the epidemiology of viral infection in a closed population. As a qualified teacher, Jamie has a particular interest in the development and delivery of high-quality teaching, and in exploring how education can adapt to the opportunities and challenges presented by the growing use of AI.
